latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Frames — Extract and Export Video Frames skill.

- Extract video frames or generate new MP4 clips from your uploaded video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Supports exporting individual frames for thumbnails or editing; ideal for YouTubers, content creators, and video editors.
- Simple cloud-based workflow: upload, describe extraction, receive 1080p exports in 20–40 seconds.
- Automatic free token and session setup for new users; no installation required.
- Includes commands for export, credits, status, and uploading, plus detailed error handling and workflow tips.
